name: OSIRIS Palantir Dashboard
description: Fork of simplifaisoul/osiris (Open Source Intelligence & Reconnaissance Integrated System): a Next.js 16 + MapLibre GL situational-awareness dashboard that aggregates live flights, AIS maritime, 17k public CCTV cameras, USGS/FIRMS/EONET hazards, GDELT/GDACS events, conflict zones, markets, cyber threats and a RECON toolkit behind roughly 70 /api routes, with Gemini-backed briefings and a Polybolos SDK ingest/SSE surface. It is the structural ancestor of Payload Terminal (same intel/, engine/, src/ layout, same intel/server.js ontology service and bytecode-only engine/ forecaster): Payload Terminal removed the person-targeting and scanning routes and added its physical-economy state; this fork keeps the full upstream surface. In the Notations Universe it is a reference operator surface and a source of OSINT layer designs, not a state holder: it persists nothing durable (in-memory caches and SDK store only) and must not become the canonical intelligence record or a person-profiling service.

capabilities.label: Liveness probe
capabilities.description: GET /api/health returns status, platform, version, uptime and a static list of principal endpoints; never touches an upstream feed.

capabilities.label: Platform statistics
capabilities.description: GET /api/stats aggregates entity counts across the live layers for the HUD status bar.

capabilities.label: Basemap tile proxy
capabilities.description: GET /api/proxy-tiles is a same-origin raster tile proxy for basemaps that block cross-origin reads; an nginx cache container (osiris-cache, :8080) fronts it in docker-compose.

capabilities.label: Interactive API docs
capabilities.description: The /docs page renders src/app/docs/apiCatalog.ts, a hand-maintained machine-readable catalog of every public /api route with params, returns, env and auth flags, plus a command palette.

capabilities.label: OSIRIS map dashboard
capabilities.description: The principal operator view: a MapLibre GL globe with 16 toggleable intelligence layers (flights, maritime, CCTV, seismic, fires, news, weather, space, cyber, conflict), HUD panels, a RECON toolkit and an AI briefing panel. Progressive per-layer loading.

capabilities.label: Live ADS-B aircraft
capabilities.description: GET /api/flights returns live aircraft bucketed by class (commercial, private, jets, military) from adsb.lol / OpenSky; optional OpenSky OAuth2 raises rate limits.

capabilities.label: Aircraft identity and flown track
capabilities.description: GET /api/aircraft resolves an icao24 to registration, type code, model and operator (adsb.lol readsb traces + adsbdb) and returns the actual flown trace rather than a straight line.

capabilities.label: Flight route resolution
capabilities.description: GET /api/flight-route races ADSBDB, HexDB and airplanes.live to map a callsign/ICAO24 to origin and destination airports; 30-min hit cache, per-source cooldown on 429.

capabilities.label: Tracked satellites and orbit propagation
capabilities.description: GET /api/satellites returns TLE-derived positions for tracked orbital objects (satellite.js SGP4); GET /api/satellites/orbit returns a propagated ground track for one object.

capabilities.label: Space weather
capabilities.description: GET /api/space-weather returns geomagnetic conditions and solar flare activity from NOAA SWPC.

capabilities.label: USGS earthquakes
capabilities.description: GET /api/earthquakes returns recent M2.5+ seismic events from the USGS GeoJSON feed.

capabilities.label: NASA FIRMS active fires
capabilities.description: GET /api/fires returns active wildfire hotspots from the keyless NASA FIRMS CSV (FIRMS_API_KEY optional for the per-area API).

capabilities.label: NASA EONET natural events
capabilities.description: GET /api/weather returns severe weather and natural events from NASA EONET; GET /api/air-quality returns ground-station air quality readings.

capabilities.label: Internet outages (IODA)
capabilities.description: GET /api/radar returns country-level internet outage events from Georgia Tech IODA; GET /api/cloudflare-radar adds Cloudflare Radar outages and attack origins when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is set (503 otherwise).

capabilities.label: Sentinel SAR scenes
capabilities.description: GET /api/sentinel lists Sentinel-1 SAR scenes covering a point via the Element84 Earth Search STAC catalog with Copernicus fallback.

capabilities.label: Conflict zones and frontlines
capabilities.description: GET /api/conflicts returns 13 static conflict zones joined with live incident reporting; GET /api/frontlines returns frontline geometry for active theatres.

capabilities.label: GDACS alerts and GDELT events
capabilities.description: GET /api/gdelt (despite the name) returns GDACS disaster alerts; GET /api/gdelt-events returns geocoded GDELT 2.0 event records (ActionGeo, quad-class filter, limit up to 2000).

capabilities.label: Country risk scoring
capabilities.description: GET /api/country-risk returns per-country risk scores alongside market session state.

capabilities.label: Region dossier
capabilities.description: GET /api/region-dossier composes a country/region intelligence summary for a map coordinate (the panel behind a map right-click).

capabilities.label: OSINT news and Telegram feed
capabilities.description: GET /api/news returns aggregated OSINT items scraped from public Telegram channel previews (OSIRIS_TELEGRAM_CHANNELS) with RSS fallback; GET /api/live-news lists 24/7 broadcast streams grouped by category.

capabilities.label: Markets, price history and crypto ticker
capabilities.description: GET /api/markets returns defence-sector equities and commodities; GET /api/markets/history returns OHLC candles for one symbol per range; GET /api/crypto returns ticker spot prices.

capabilities.label: Supply-chain supplier risk overlay
capabilities.description: GET /api/scm-suppliers intersects live threats (earthquakes, fires, conflicts) with static Tier 1/2 supplier coordinates and flags criticality.

capabilities.label: Public CCTV networks
capabilities.description: GET /api/cctv lists 17,000+ public cameras filtered by region or radius; /api/cctv/stream-status probes reachability, /api/cctv/proxy is a same-origin stream proxy (SSRF-guarded), /api/cctv/resolve turns SkylineWebcams and YouTube /live links into embeddable streams.

capabilities.label: Strategic infrastructure
capabilities.description: GET /api/infrastructure returns fixed strategic infrastructure such as nuclear power plants and facilities worldwide.

capabilities.label: Ports, chokepoints and AIS vessels
capabilities.description: GET /api/maritime returns 39 ports, 10 chokepoints and vessel positions (aisstream.io when AIS_API_KEY is set).

capabilities.label: ArcGIS public feature services
capabilities.description: GET /api/arcgis searches ArcGIS Online for public Feature Services (?q&bbox) or runs a spatial query against one (?service&bbox) and returns GeoJSON.

capabilities.label: Cyber threats, attacks and malware
capabilities.description: GET /api/cyber-threats returns recent CVE disclosures with rollups; /api/cyber-attacks returns observed attack events for the threat map; /api/malware returns indicators from public trackers.

capabilities.label: Client IP geolocation
capabilities.description: GET /api/geo geolocates the calling client by IP to centre the map.

capabilities.label: Location search
capabilities.description: GET /api/geosearch merges Photon autocomplete with Nominatim for the route planner.

capabilities.label: Turn-by-turn directions
capabilities.description: GET /api/directions routes via Valhalla with OSRM fallback (auto/bicycle/pedestrian) and normalises both to one shape.

capabilities.label: Domain and network reconnaissance
capabilities.description: GET /api/osint/{dns,whois,certs,ip,bgp,mac,shodan,threats,cve}: DNS records, WHOIS, certificate-transparency subdomains, IP geolocation/ASN, BGP prefixes, MAC vendor, Shodan exposure, indicator reputation and full NVD CVE records. Keyless, rate-limited per client IP.
capabilities.evidence: src/app/api/osint/dns/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/whois/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/certs/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/ip/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/bgp/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/mac/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/shodan/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/threats/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/cve/route.ts

capabilities.label: Person-targeting OSINT (username, phone, leaks, GitHub, infostealer)
capabilities.description: GET /api/osint/{username,phone,leaks,github,hudsonrock}: Sherlock-style username enumeration, E.164 phone classification, breach-corpus checks, GitHub profile metadata and Hudson Rock infostealer lookups. These are the capabilities Payload Terminal deleted; they remain here because this fork tracks upstream OSIRIS.
capabilities.evidence: src/app/api/osint/username/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/phone/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/leaks/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/github/route.ts; src/app/api/osint/hudsonrock/route.ts; src/lib/sherlock.ts

capabilities.label: OFAC SDN sanctions search
capabilities.description: GET /api/osint/sanctions searches the OpenSanctions mirror of the US OFAC SDN list for persons, organisations and vessels.

capabilities.label: On-chain wallet intelligence
capabilities.description: GET /api/osint/crypto traces BTC/ETH/SOL wallets (balance, history, counterparties) via mempool.space, Blockscout and Solana RPC, screens against OFAC SDN and risk-scores; ?probe=1 reports which optional keys (ETHERSCAN_API_KEY, HELIUS_API_KEY) are active.

capabilities.label: Daily chain-threat brief
capabilities.description: GET /api/chain/daily?days= aggregates DefiLlama on-chain exploits, blockchain CVEs from NVD and newly designated OFAC wallets into a dated digest with per-section degradation flags.

capabilities.label: Host sweep
capabilities.description: GET /api/osint/sweep probes a single address or CIDR range for reachable hosts. Active network contact with third-party targets, so it is marked execute even though it writes no state.

capabilities.label: RECON scanner backend proxy
capabilities.description: GET /api/scanner forwards quick/ssl/headers/rdns/subdomains/tech/whois/geoloc/vuln scans to the separate OSIRIS scanner backend at SCANNER_URL with SCANNER_KEY; returns 503 when unconfigured. Active scanning of a target is an external side effect.
capabilities.side_effects: active scans against the target host

capabilities.label: Ontology graph expansion
capabilities.description: GET /api/entity/expand?type&id forwards to the osiris-intel service (INTEL_URL, http://osiris-intel:4000/resolve in Docker) and returns a {nodes, links} graph with sanctions-match edges for the entity graph panel.

capabilities.label: Bundled osiris-intel /resolve service
capabilities.description: intel/server.js (Express 5, port 4000) ships in this repo and resolves aircraft, vessel, company, person, IP and country entities against an in-memory OpenSanctions index plus Wikidata; GET /health exposes index counts. Same code the osiris-intel node catalogs from Payload-Terminal-V0.

capabilities.label: AI cross-feed analysis
capabilities.description: POST /api/ai/analyze correlates an intelligence context across feeds and returns a threat assessment via the Gemini engine.

capabilities.label: AI threat briefing
capabilities.description: POST /api/ai/briefing produces a structured daily-intelligence-style threat briefing from the supplied feed context.

capabilities.label: AI overview highlights
capabilities.description: POST /api/ai/overview returns a terse 2-4 sentence situational read-out for the Alerts or Markets panel.

capabilities.label: ASTRA image geolocation proxy
capabilities.description: POST /api/astra forwards an uploaded image to a GPU geolocation server at ASTRA_GPU_URL (/geolocate) and returns its estimate. Triggers external compute.

capabilities.label: Polybolos SDK entity ingest
capabilities.description: POST /api/sdk/ingest accepts {source, apiKey, entities[]} in Polybolos format (e.g. translated Anduril Lattice tracks) and merges them into the in-memory common operating picture; fail-closed unless SDK_INGEST_KEY is set.

capabilities.label: SDK ingest status
capabilities.description: GET /api/sdk/ingest reports how many external entities are held plus recent ingest history.

capabilities.label: SDK entity SSE stream
capabilities.description: GET /api/sdk/stream opens a Server-Sent Events connection pushing normalised Polybolos entities as they arrive.

capabilities.label: GitHub webhook relay
capabilities.description: POST /api/github-webhook verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 with GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET and forwards the event to GITHUB_WEBHOOK_FORWARD_URL; 503 when unconfigured.
capabilities.side_effects: forwards payload to an external URL

capabilities.label: Polybolos entity wire contract
capabilities.description: The PolybolosEntity type (domain, entity type, threat level, classification, position) that /api/sdk/ingest accepts and /api/sdk/stream emits; LatticeAdapter shows the translation from Lattice tracks.

relations.description: Confirmed by code: /api/entity/expand is a thin proxy that forwards resolve requests to the intel service at INTEL_URL (http://osiris-intel:4000 in Docker, localhost:4000 in dev), and docker-compose.yml builds the osiris-intel container from ./intel. The intel/server.js in this repo is the same Express service the osiris-intel node catalogs from Payload-Terminal-V0/intel.

Inferred from bytecode and the ledger: engine/__pycache__/osiris_intake.cpython-314.pyc and runs/ledger.jsonl (brief + forecast records) are present in this repo, matching the Pythia forecaster that reads OSIRIS /api/* feeds at OSIRIS_URL to build its world brief. No Python source is committed here, so the direction is inferred from module naming and the ledger contents rather than confirmed from readable code.

external_services.purpose: live aircraft state vectors and traces

external_services.purpose: callsign to route and aircraft identity

reference.spatial: Global: every layer is geocoded (aircraft, vessels, cameras, hazards, events, infrastructure) on a MapLibre globe; no single home location.
reference.temporal: Live polling at 15-30 minute relaxations for stable feeds and near-real-time for aircraft; markets history back to one year; chain brief up to 120 days; nothing is archived.
open_questions: engine/ is bytecode-only here as in Payload Terminal; which repository is the canonical home of the Pythia forecaster source?
Person-targeting routes (username, phone, leaks, hudsonrock) are still served; should this fork adopt Payload Terminal's collection policy or stay a pure upstream mirror?
No Gemini API key env name is referenced in the .env.example although @google/generative-ai is a dependency; confirm how ai-engine.ts is configured.
docker-compose references an external umami_default network; is analytics part of the intended deployment?
